item.title: `fselect` Find files with SQL-like queries
item.content:encoded:
• fselect Find files with SQL-like queries
    • Recap: to do something in place of find/fd. not really interested on it anymore.
    • Run: 
      fselect size, path from $pwd where size gt 10mb
gci -recurse | where Length -gt 10mb # equivalent in powershell... so `fselect` is kinda useless in Windows.
    • Resolution:
      • #syntax Columns and fields - fselect
    • Reason:
      • Pro: lightweight runtime, almost no dependency, a #linux native tools.
      • Con: IT's completedly inferior compare to a whole dotnet runtime in powershell.
    • Root: in scoop.
      • #discussion : An Open File Format for storing the information from a forge such as issues, pull/merge requests, milestones
        • Recap: f3/gof3: Read a software project from a forge and convert it into the Friendly Forge Format. Read from the Friendly Forge Format and write to a software project in a forge
    • Related: #git git task
      • project management software. Like github projects / jira / gitlab. This one is local first.
        • This work as a perfect todo management, I don need taskwarrior for this.
        • The could one is a huge kanban board. I'm not really into that.
      • It's like a gh ic, but I dont have to make round trip to browsers.
